title: Tirak — Local Guides for Cultural Experiences in Thailand
description: Find local guides for cultural experiences in Thailand, starting in Bangkok. Browse guided walks and workshops in the Tirak app, or apply as a local guide.

title: Get Tirak — Android App and iPhone Web App
description: Get Tirak on Google Play or save the Tirak web app to your iPhone Home Screen. Invited testers can also use TestFlight.

title: Apply as a Local Guide — Tirak
description: Apply as a local guide for cultural experiences in Thailand. Submit your profile, services and weekly availability for review by the Tirak team. Founding guides pay 0% commission until 7 March 2027.
